gallery.description: The railway station at Needham Market in Suffolk was built in 1846 to the designs of Frederick Barnes. His grand battlemented and diapered offices are no longer used by the railway so entrance to the platform is through the arch on the right. It merits two stars in Simon Jenkins' Britain's 100 Best Railway Stations.
categories: Railway infrastructure photographs by Geof Sheppard
